item.title: The Best Vintage Looks From The 2026 Awards Season
item.description: From Elle Fanning in ’50s Nettie Rosenstein to Kylie Jenner in ’90s Versace, there’s already been a number of vintage dresses this awards season. See the best vintage dresses from the 2026 awards season.

item.title: David Jonsson Is Coming For Paul Mescal’s Cardigan Collection
item.description: At the Critics’ Circle Theatre Awards in London over the weekend, David Jonsson opted for a sumptuous pink tweed mohair cardigan, paired with green silk cargo pants, a white shirt and striped tie.

item.title: At The 2026 Grammys, A New Kind Of Naked Dressing Trend
item.description: From Chappell Roan’s risqué Mugler moment to Harry Styles, bare-chested in Dior, the stars weren’t afraid to show some skin on the red carpet at music’s big night out.

item.title: A Look Back At Catherine O’Hara’s 8 Most Memorable Performances
item.description: From ‘Beetlejuice’ and ‘Home Alone’ to ‘Schitt’s Creek’ and ‘The Studio’, the late actor Catherine O’Hara’s comedic genius is on full display. These are her 8 best films and TV shows.

item.title: The Winter Sun Outfits Team Vogue Are Packing For Their Next Trip
item.description: Travelling abroad this winter? Browse the Vogue approved winter sun outfits for the best brands to know and a ready-made winter sun packing list.

item.title: Everything We Know So Far About The Four-Part Beatles Biopic
item.description: Sam Mendes’s series of four interconnected biopics following each member of The Beatles will feature Harris Dickinson as John Lennon, Paul Mescal as Paul McCartney, Joseph Quinn as George Harrison, and Barry Keoghan as Ringo Starr. Here’s everything we know so far.

item.title: 30 Pitch-Perfect Rom-Coms To Watch Now
item.description: Depending on who you ask, Valentine’s Day is either the sole thing that makes February bearable or Hallmark-sponsored hell. Whichever side of the debate you fall on, you can find validation – or solace – in a good rom-com. Below, Vogue rounds up 30 of the best.

item.title: The 16 Best Brown Lipsticks To Help You Nail This Year’s Essential Beauty Look
item.description: “The brown lipsticks of now are considered, elevated, uncompromising and aloof,” writes Sali Hughes, who argues that it actually tops red when it comes to beauty classics. “In fashion terms, it seems that brown lipstick might just be The Row of make-up.”

item.title: Expect To See Your Boyfriend In Ballet Flats Before Long
item.description: Harry Styles took to the Grammys stage in a surprising choice of footwear: a pair of bow-adorned Dior flats. Read on for why ballet flats for the men will be the next biggest menswear trend.

item.title: Slippers Are The Unexpected Shoe Trend Of 2026
item.description: Slippers outside? The street-style set say yes! Vogue looks at the slipper shoe trend and highlights the styles that are worthy of wear out in the wild.
